computeCompileAuthority: Player build logs are the authoritative compute compile check (grep 'Shader error in 'ClusteredDeferred'' = 0 in both logs). ShaderUtil.GetComputeShaderMessageCount under-reported a broken variant set in the shadow round and must not be used as the acceptance signal.
mixedLightingStatus: PARTIAL: the kernel/include and the pass bindings implement the deferred mixed lighting branch, but no runtime A/B exists. Deferred mixed mode detection reads Light.bakingOutput; an editor probe showed Light.lightmapBakeType = Mixed at runtime leaves bakingOutput.lightmapBakeType = Realtime, and m_BakingOutput.isBaked = false cannot be produced without a GI bake. The arena has no baked lightmap/probe data, so shadowmask values would be constant white.
